title: Chapter 304 Attacking Wagner'S Main Force
content:
Chapter 304 Attacking Wagner'S Main Force

After deciding to go to the rescue, a new problem was put in front of us.

Wagner's army is still stationed in the pass. If they want to go to Changping County, this is an unavoidable obstacle.

"What do you think if we go from the south or north?"

"As far as I know, there are also undead stationed in those two directions."

"It seems that there is no other way but to attack Wagner."

"By the way, mayors, do you still have dead spirit beads or death aura talismans!"

A lord suddenly said.

"Yes, I feel that my troops have begun to suffer from the invasion of death. I hope you have extra props to resist death and sell some to me. Otherwise, it will be difficult for me to support the next battle."

"Me too, this dead spirit bead seems to be incomplete and cannot absorb death infinitely."

At this time, the lord of Nanshan Club looked surprised and suspicious. Don't these people know that the dead spirit bead was made by Wang Shuo?

Seeing that Wang Shuo didn't say anything, they didn't say anything.

Wang Shuo saw that the time was ripe and said slowly: "Everyone, I still have some dead spirit beads here. You can exchange them with dead spirit beads that are full of dead energy. Just make up the difference."

Hearing Wang Shuo say this, the others finally breathed a sigh of relief.

After exchanging the dead spirit beads, the mayors and lords began to reorganize their troops.

But who was responsible for the lead and who was responsible for the offensive battle, everyone fell into a quarrel again.

Seeing that these people didn't want to contribute, Wang Shuo couldn't help shaking his head.

"Everyone, don't have to argue anymore. I can be responsible for breaking down the opposite pass, but you all have to send your main force to rush up to fight the offensive battle, how about it?"

Destroying the terrain advantage of the opposite side can be said to be the most important and difficult step in this battle.

Since Wang Shuo has already said this, if everyone still blames each other, it is better to return to their own territory early and wait for death.

After seeing tens of thousands of troops, if these mayors and lords dispersed, it would really be like waiting for death.

After all, even if they just wiped out nearly 20,000 undead army in Changping County, there are probably more than 100,000 people, including those wiped out by allies in other directions.

The pass where Wagner is located has cliffs on both sides and a wide dry river in the middle, which is also tens of meters wide.

At 2.5 kilometers away, Wang Shuo asked Li Jianguo to deploy the crossbow battalion in five columns.

This time, a total of 50 catapults were brought.

After the battle in the valley, Wang Shuo had asked Wana Town to transport some more ammunition.

Including a large number of thunder and catapult projectiles.

Enough to blast the pass.

The other lords and mayors who accompanied him were all shocked when they saw the formation Wang Shuo had set up.

Under such powerful long-range firepower, his city might not be able to defend at all!

For a time, the strength of Wang Shuo's Wana Town was raised again, and it was included in the category of not being easily attacked by enemies.

"Fire."

Fifty bullets drew a graceful arc in the sky, carrying the meaning of death, and hit the wall of the pass.

There was a deafening explosion.

"Bang, bang..."

The wall of the pass was not made of bronze bricks like the wall of a city, but was made of some huge stones.

Each huge stone weighed several tons, but there was no formation connected to it. The explosion of the bullets quickly cracked the huge stone, and even part of the wall collapsed in just one round of attack.

After another round of attack, gaps began to appear in the wall.
